notes.title: Patch 1.0.4a and Guide v1.0.2

tags.bug: The bug in which the ancient medallion wasn't unlocked in the Extra menu has been fixed;
Messages about Solo Ending A and Solo Ending B were appearing in the wrong positions;
There was an extra frame in one of Grivoth's NSFW gallery in a scene it shouldn't have;
There were some wrong lines in Bad Ending #6. Now, they have been fixed;

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3a and Guide 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. We've received bug reports and we have fixed them. Check out what has changed.

Patch 1.0.3a
[olist]
[*] Some dialogue lines have been fixed. They were showing code commands;
[*] Solo Ending B - Unleashed Beast Ending has been fixed;
[/olist]
Guide 1.0.1
[list]
[*] The option "Invite Ulfric to rest together" has been removed from the guide. It's a choice only available in the NSFW DLC but it doesn't have any influence to unlock the endings. 
[*] Boris Ending A - The Warrior's Rest has been fixed.
[/list]
We really appreciate your feedback, especially Dragon's and Daddy Hyperion's ones sent on our forum [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1949440/discussions/0/3457094584917373432/]topic[/url].

Male Doll Team
